`pagerankr` models PageRank on crawl data for SEO work. Give it an edge list,
a redirect report or a Screaming Frog crawl export, and it resolves redirects
and canonicals, builds the link graph, and scores how authority flows through
the site's internal links. Beyond PageRank it computes HITS, SALSA, TrustRank
and topic-sensitive PageRank, compares models across parameter sweeps,
simulates proposed link and redirect changes, and exports the graph for other
tools. It is for SEO practitioners and analysts who want to measure internal
linking from the crawls they already have.

## Installation

```r
# From CRAN
install.packages("pagerankr")

# From r-universe
install.packages(
  "pagerankr",
  repos = c("https://bart-turczynski.r-universe.dev", "https://cloud.r-project.org")
)
```

## Quick Start

```r
library(pagerankr)

edges <- data.frame(
  from = c("http://example.com/home",
           "http://example.com/about",
           "http://example.com/blog"),
  to   = c("http://example.com/about",
           "http://example.com/home",
           "http://example.com/home")
)

redirects <- data.frame(
  from = "http://example.com/old-blog",
  to   = "http://example.com/blog"
)

pr <- pagerank(edges, redirects_df = redirects)
print(pr)
```
